Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced a worn out brinkman. Glad I did. Great even cooking, haven’t found any cold spots.
Results.Title: 1st Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This Weber Grill is living up to its brand name. It looks great and does the job in grilling our food.  It is easy to keep clean and I hope to get many years of use from this well-priced grill.
Results.Title: Great addition for our outdoor grilling

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love this grill it meets all of my expectations of Weber
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The grill was easier than expected to assemble and has performed as expected so far. I wanted a grill that would last and that was easy to maintain.
Results.Title: Simple and sturdy.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After cooking on my Weber Charcoal grill for the last 20 years I finally decided to try a gas grill. Very happy with the convenience and results and am re-learning how to cook. Recipes and other email suggestions are helpful and appreciated.
Results.Title: Easy to use

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have had many grills over the years and some were high-end. This grill is great. The cooking time is shorter and the grill marks are perfect. I don’t have to worry about flair-ups and burning the food.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: As for the grill  performance I would rate it 5 stars. However, the warming rack does not fit into the slots in the grill body. Weber sent a second rack , but the same problem
Results.Title: Grill Review

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
